notes:
- No more port forwarding or firewall rules: co-op now connects with WebRTC. The online lobby service
  introduces the players, then their games connect directly, or through Cloudflare's relay when a direct
  connection isn't possible (some routers and mobile networks).
- Co-op in the browser version too (host or join online games).
- LAN games still show up by themselves and JOIN BY IP still works on a LAN.
- Updating from v0.16 inside the game: v0.17 fetches its co-op library (about 4 MB) once on first start and
  restarts by itself.
- Everyone needs v0.17 to play together (older versions can't connect to it).
